title: 第 9 章 卡规则截胡无损夺回灵泉第 10 章 良心暴击修为暴涨初逆袭
lines: 夜幕彻底笼罩青玄宗群山，墨色云层压低山头，山间夜风卷着草木凉意掠过灵泉山谷。收到系统预警的陆衍站在后山密林深处，借着参天古树的阴影藏身，眉头冷静舒展，没有半分焦躁。苏临时增派人手、加装预警法阵看似防备拉满，可他根基短板摆在明面上，只懂在外围布控，根本摸不透灵泉上古阵法的内在运转规律，这便是陆破局最大的突破口。
赵小胖白天送来的情报里写明，苏辰新增的巡逻人手全部排布在山谷平地、正门山道，新增预警法阵只绑定泉眼表层灵气波动，没办法监测阵法内部脉络改动，恰好给了陆钻规则空子的机会。距离灵泉超长灵气真空窗口期仅剩一个时辰，整片泉域的护阵即将进入休眠，天地间流转的灵泉本源会短暂失去束缚，正是千载难逢的改归属时机。
陆衍压下立刻动身的念头，靠着连日行善积攒的功德抵消天道残留厄运，脚下原本想要绊倒的碎石凭空滑向一旁，路边疯长的荆棘也没能缠上裤脚。连日积攒的功德不断削弱天道针对，厄运deb已经只剩零星效果，赶路带来的意外阻碍大幅变少。他耐心蹲在崖边，清点谷内巡逻修士的轮换规律，新增五名巡逻弟子分成两班，半个时辰换一次岗，换班的短短片刻便是巡逻盲区。
等第一波换班间隙到来，陆衍身形一闪，借着崖壁藤蔓稳稳落地，悄无声息钻入灵泉谷地深处。谷中灯火零星散落，几名巡逻弟子手持照明玉符慢悠悠踱步闲聊，注意力全都盯着泉眼表面的灵气变化，没人留意地底阵法纹路正在被人悄然撬动。苏辰此刻在谷中石屋闭关调息，连日吸收灵液修炼太过疲惫，早早盘膝入定熟睡，对外界后山的异动毫无察觉。
陆衍径直来到泉眼核心位置，蹲下身指尖轻触地面，顺着蜿蜒的上古阵纹细细摸索。苏辰连日粗暴汲取灵液，把原本闭环的灵泉阵法拆得七零八落，大量本源灵气顺着破损阵纹白白外泄，整片灵泉根基持续受损，再任由苏霸占用不了十日，陆家祖传灵便会彻底枯竭。陆按照提前推演的方案，不破坏阵体、不引爆灵气，只用自身精纯炼气灵力顺着残缺纹路一点点修补阵法闭环，慢慢修改灵泉的地脉归属契约。
按照玄洲修仙界封地法则，灵泉地脉扎根陆家封地，只要阵法本源重新和陆家地契脉络相连，灵液便会自主回流，全程不需要抢夺、不需要动手伤人，完全卡在天地规则和宗门律法之内，完美契合系统良心奖励的触发条件。
时间缓缓流逝，真空窗口期稳步降临，泉眼白雾骤然变淡，源源不断的灵泉本源顺着修复后的阵脉，顺着地底地脉朝着陆家封地方向缓缓流淌。原本源源不断涌入苏辰居所的淡金色天命气运，被地脉规则强行截断，一缕缕本该属于苏的气运顺着灵泉本源反向飘回天地之间，再被陆衍身上的功德金光缓缓收纳。
沉睡在石屋中的苏辰猛然心神一颤，体内灵气莫名溃散，从打坐入定的状态骤然惊醒。他脸色一变，慌忙起身冲出石屋直奔泉眼，周身原本浑厚的气运肉眼可见缩水大半，修炼了大半的修为出现莫名回落。苏急匆匆围着泉眼来回巡查，指尖反复探查表层预警法阵，法阵完好无损，周边巡逻弟子也全程在岗，山谷里没有外人闯入的半点痕迹，泉眼灵气却实实在在不再向自己供给。
他又气又急，翻遍整片灵泉山谷，查遍所有陷阱和预警符文，愣是找不到半分人为动手的痕迹，只能归咎于自身修炼出了岔子、灵气反噬，满心憋屈却找不到发泄对象，连控诉陆衍的理由都找不出来。想要去找宗门长老哭诉，可没有任何证据佐证是陆动手，反倒会被长老追问为何好好的灵泉突然灵气断供，白白落个保管不力的罪名，最后只能憋着一肚子闷气，眼睁睁看着灵泉本源不断回流陆家地界。
躲在远处灌木丛里的陆衍静静看着苏手足无措的模样，内心波澜不起，从一开始就没打算靠蛮力争抢，规则层面的碾压才是最稳妥的制衡手段。全程没有辱骂、没有动手、没有重伤任何一人，既拿回自家祖产，又守住了自己的良心底线，彻底避开原主无脑硬刚触发系统天谴、白白给苏送气运的死路。
灵泉本源全数回流完毕，地底阵纹彻底稳固，陆衍不再逗留，趁着夜色顺着后山原路悄然撤离，片刻功夫便离开灵谷范围，踏上返回陆家别院的山路。一路之上天道零星厄运还在试图作祟，一阵怪风吹起尘土扑面而来，可功德护体之下风沙刚到身前便自动散开，赶路全程顺顺利利。
回到自家院落，天色刚至后半夜，周伯和赵小胖还在院内焦急等候，见陆衍安然归来，连忙上前追问灵泉进展。陆淡淡点头，告知灵泉已经靠着阵法规则尽数收回，两人瞬间喜出望外，悬了数日的心彻底落地。赵小胖搓着手兴奋不已，原本还担心少爷要大打出手惹上麻烦，没想到轻轻松松靠着规矩拿回祖传宝贝。
就在三人闲谈之时，陆衍脑海里清脆的系统提示音接连炸响。【叮！宿主依托天地规则拿回自有灵泉，全程不伤一人、不结仇怨、坚守良心底线，完美达成顶级良心判定！】【良心暴击奖励开始发放！海量精纯灵气涌入宿主丹田！】
海量温润灵气瞬间从四面八方涌入陆衍经脉，原本卡在炼气三层许久的瓶颈轰然碎裂，修为一路飙升，转瞬突破炼气四层、五层，最后稳稳定格在炼气巅峰。体内原本被天道压制的滞涩灵气彻底疏通，连日积攒的功德全部和新修为融为一体，同时解锁被动天赋【微末气运制衡】，往后天道对天命之子的气运倾斜会被小幅削弱。
陆凝神查看系统新解锁的天赋说明，嘴角勾起一抹淡笑，从此苏辰再想靠着天道无脑开挂，气运加成会被自己被动削弱，后续制衡难度持续下降。
可还没等陆细细消化暴涨的修为，系统冰冷预警突然响起。【紧急预警！灵泉气运大规模回流引发天道震怒，全域厄运buff再次升级，明日开始全宗门舆论定向抹黑宿主，苏辰将借着灵气反噬的由头大肆卖惨，全网唾骂模式即将开启！】
content_en:
Night completely enveloped the Qingxuanzong Mountains, dark clouds lowered the mountain tops, and the night wind in the mountains carried the coolness of the vegetation across the Lingquan Valley. After receiving the system warning, Lu Yan stood deep in the dense forest at the back of the mountain, hiding in the shadow of the towering ancient trees, his brows calm and relaxed, not a little anxious. Su's temporary deployment of additional manpower and the installation of early warning formations seemed to have full defense, but his basic shortcomings were obvious. He only knew how to control the outside and could not understand the inner workings of the ancient Lingquan formation. This was Lu's biggest breakthrough.
The intelligence sent by Zhao Xiaopang during the day stated that Su Chen's newly added patrols were all deployed on the valley plains and on the main mountain road. The newly added early warning array was only bound to the spiritual energy fluctuations on the surface of the spring. There was no way to monitor changes in the array's internal context, which gave Lu Zuan an opportunity to loop through the rules. There is only one hour left before the spiritual spring's ultra-long spiritual energy vacuum window period. The protective formation of the entire spring area is about to enter dormancy. The source of the spiritual spring flowing between heaven and earth will temporarily lose its restraint. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to change its ownership.
Lu Yan suppressed the idea of ​​setting off immediately, relying on the merits he had accumulated from doing good deeds over the past few days to offset the remaining misfortune of heaven. The gravel he was trying to trip over slipped to the side out of thin air, and the thorns growing wildly on the roadside failed to wrap around his trousers. The merits accumulated over the past few days have continuously weakened the Heavenly Dao, and the bad luck deb has only sporadic effects, and the unexpected obstacles caused by the journey have been greatly reduced. He squatted patiently on the edge of the cliff and took stock of the rotation patterns of the patrolling monks in the valley. The five new patrolling disciples were divided into two shifts. They changed posts every half an hour. The short period of shift change was the patrol blind spot.
When the first wave of shift breaks came, Lu Yan flashed, landed steadily on the cliff vines, and quietly slipped into the depths of Lingquan Valley. Lights were scattered in the valley, and several patrolling disciples were walking slowly and chatting with lighting jade talismans, all focusing on the changes in the aura on the surface of the spring. No one noticed that the underground formation patterns were being quietly disturbed. Su Chen was currently in seclusion and regulating his breath in the stone house in the valley. He was too exhausted from absorbing the spiritual liquid for days and fell into a deep sleep early in the morning, unaware of the unusual movements in the mountains behind.
Lu Yan went straight to the core of the spring, squatted down and touched the ground with his fingertips, groping carefully along the winding ancient formation lines. Su Chen roughly absorbed the spiritual liquid for days, tearing the originally closed-loop spiritual spring formation to pieces. A large amount of original spiritual energy leaked out along the damaged formation lines. The foundation of the entire spiritual spring continued to be damaged. If Su Ba was not allowed to occupy it for another ten days, the Lu family's ancestral spirit would be completely exhausted. According to the plan deduced in advance, Lu did not destroy the formation or detonate the spiritual energy. He only used his own pure energy to repair the closed loop of the formation little by little along the incomplete lines, and slowly modified the contract of ownership of the earth veins of Lingquan.
According to the rules of the Xuanzhou Cultivation World's fiefdom, the Lingquan land veins are rooted in the Lu family's fiefdom. As long as the origin of the formation is reconnected with the Lu family's land deed veins, the spiritual liquid will flow back on its own. There is no need to rob or hurt anyone in the whole process. It is completely stuck within the rules of heaven and earth and the laws of the sect, which perfectly meets the triggering conditions of the system's conscience reward.
Time passed slowly, the vacuum window period steadily came, the white mist in the spring suddenly faded, and the source of the endless spiritual spring slowly flowed along the repaired formation veins, and along the underground veins towards the Lu family's fiefdom. The pale golden fate that originally poured into Su Chen's residence was forcibly cut off by the rules of the earth's veins. Wisps of luck that should have belonged to Su floated back to the space between heaven and earth along the source of the spiritual spring, and were slowly absorbed by the golden light of merit on Lu Yan's body.
Su Chen, who was sleeping in the stone house, suddenly trembled. The spiritual energy in his body collapsed inexplicably, and he suddenly woke up from a meditative state. His expression changed, and he hurriedly stood up and rushed out of the stone house and headed straight for the spring. The original strong luck around him could be seen with the naked eye to have shrunk by more than half, and the cultivation that he had practiced for most of it had declined inexplicably. Su hurriedly patrolled back and forth around the spring, and repeatedly probed the surface of the early warning array with his fingertips. The array was intact, and the surrounding patrolling disciples were on guard throughout. There was no trace of outsiders intruding in the valley, but the spiritual energy of the spring was no longer supplied to him.
He was angry and anxious. He searched the entire Lingquan Valley, checked all the traps and warning runes, but couldn't find any trace of human intervention. He could only blame it on his own cultivation that went wrong and the spiritual energy backlash. He was full of frustration but couldn't find anyone to vent to. He couldn't even find a reason to accuse Lu Yan. He wanted to cry to the elders of the sect, but there was no evidence to prove that Lu was responsible. Instead, he would be asked by the elders why the spiritual energy of the good spiritual spring was suddenly cut off, and he was accused of poor storage. In the end, he could only suffocate and watch the source of the spiritual spring continue to flow back into the Lu family's territory.
Lu Yan, who was hiding in the bushes in the distance, quietly looked at Su's helpless appearance, feeling uneasy in his heart. From the beginning, he had no intention of relying on brute force to fight. Smashing at the level of rules was the most reliable means of checks and balances. There were no insults, no physical attacks, and no serious injuries to anyone during the whole process. Not only did he get back his ancestral property, but he also kept his bottom line of conscience, and completely avoided the original owner's unintended consequences of triggering the system's divine punishment and sending Su's luck in vain.
All the sources of the spiritual springs had returned, and the underground formations were completely stable. Lu Yan no longer stayed, and quietly evacuated along the original road in the back mountain under the cover of night. In a short time, he left the Spirit Valley area and set foot on the mountain road back to the Lu Family Villa. Along the way, sporadic misfortunes from heaven were still trying to cause trouble, and a strange wind blew up dust in front of my face. However, under the protection of merit, the wind and sand automatically dispersed as soon as they arrived in front of me, so the whole journey went smoothly.
Returning to their courtyard, it was just after midnight, and Uncle Zhou and Zhao Xiaopang were still waiting anxiously in the courtyard. Seeing that Lu Yan had returned safely, they quickly stepped forward to ask about the progress of Lingquan. Lu nodded lightly and informed that Lingquan had been recovered by relying on the rules of the formation. The two of them were overjoyed in an instant, and their hearts that had been hanging for several days were completely settled. Zhao Xiaopang was rubbing his hands in excitement. He was originally worried that the young master would fight and get into trouble, but he didn't expect that he could easily get back the ancestral treasure by relying on the rules.
While the three of them were chatting, the clear system prompts in Lu Yan's mind rang one after another. 【bite! The host relies on the rules of heaven and earth to get back his own spiritual spring. No one is harmed, no grudges are made, and the bottom line of conscience is adhered to in the whole process, and the top-level conscience judgment is perfectly achieved! 】【Conscience critical strike rewards have begun to be distributed! A massive amount of pure spiritual energy poured into the host's Dantian! 】
A large amount of warm spiritual energy poured into Lu Yan's meridians from all directions in an instant. The bottleneck that had been stuck on the third level of Qi refining for a long time suddenly shattered. His cultivation soared, breaking through the fourth and fifth levels of Qi refining in an instant, and finally stabilized at the peak of Qi refining. The stagnant spiritual energy in the body that was originally suppressed by the Heavenly Dao is completely unblocked, and all the merits accumulated over the past few days are integrated with the new cultivation. At the same time, the passive talent [Small Luck Control and Balance] is unlocked. In the future, the fate of the Child of Destiny will be slightly weakened by the Heavenly Dao.
Lu Ningshen checked the description of the newly unlocked talents in the system, with a faint smile on his lips. From now on, if Su Chen wants to rely on the way of heaven to cheat without thinking, the luck bonus will be passively weakened by himself, and the difficulty of subsequent checks and balances will continue to decrease.
But before Lu Xiuxian could digest the skyrocketing cultivation level, the system's cold warning suddenly sounded. 【Emergency warning! The large-scale return of spiritual energy has triggered the wrath of heaven, and the global bad luck buff has been upgraded again. Tomorrow, the entire sect's public opinion will begin to smear the host. Su Chen will use the backlash of spiritual energy to cause a lot of misery, and the entire network's scolding mode is about to begin! 】

title_en: Chapter 9: Cutting off the spirit spring without any damage due to card rules Chapter 10: The first counterattack with a sharp increase in conscience critical attack
